unproject_masked_depth_to_xyz_coordinate: unproject a batch of masked depth images to XYZ coordinates using camera pose and inverse intrinsics
depth_to_xyz: convert a depth tensor to XYZ coordinates using a pinhole camera model and Camera object
add_additive_noise_to_xyz: add approximate Gaussian Process noise to an ordered point cloud tensor for data augmentation
dropout_random_ellipses: randomly dropout elliptical regions from a depth image tensor for robustness training
get_one_point_per_voxel_from_pointcloud: downsample a point cloud by selecting one point per voxel grid cell with optional random centers
